QuestInfo.name: [Elodin] Another Chance!
QuestInfo.0: It seems those flowers were useless. All that work for nothing... Oh, well. Talk to the #b#p1501004##k.
QuestInfo.1:
The #b#p1501004##k needs you to hunt Spring Spirits in the #bTwilit Forest#k to get Pure Water and Lotus Flowers.

This time, the #i4220196:# #b#t4220196:##k will fill up automatically when you collect #i2630243:# #b#t2630243:##k. Double-click the #i4220196:# #b#t4220196:##k to see how much water you've collected.
QuestInfo.2: You gave the bottle and lotus flowers to the #b#p1501003##k. See if that helped him at all.

0.conditionContent: Fill the bottle with Pure Water

0.msg: Would you bring Pure Water and lotus flowers one more time?

1.msg: Please fill this Small Bottle with #r21 droplets of Pure Water#k and find #r10 Lotus Blossoms#k. That should be just enough to do the trick.

2.msg: This bottle will automatically fill every time you get Pure Water, so you won't have to pick it up yourself anymore.

3.msg: That would have been helpful earlier...

5.msg: Well, earlier I didn't realize you were such a whiner. Maybe I won't give you this bottle after all.

6.msg: No! Forget I said that! I love running errands for you!

7.msg: Ooh! More water and flowers! I can't wait!

0.msg: This time ought to do the trick, right?
Aren't you going to help us?
Here you are. More Pure Water and Lotus Flowers to help you sing beautifully.

1.msg: So I just drink all the water and eat all the flowers again?
How do you feel this time?

0.msg: Please fill the small bottle with Pure Water and pick a few more Lotus Flowers for me.
